item.description:
Added

  • Bromehew updates itself with Sparkle: Bromehew › Check for Updates… and automatic checks, configurable in Settings › General. Updates must carry the EdDSA signature of the Bromehew release key.
  • Releases are signed with a Developer ID, notarized and published as a disk image and as the Homebrew cask appnoe/bromehew/bromehew. Tools/release/release.sh does the whole release, from the version number derived from the changelog to the git-flow merges, tag and push.
  • After an update, a running menu bar app replaces itself with the new version.

Changed

  • New menu bar icon: the mug from the app icon, full when updates are available, with their number punched into it in small type. A “!” in the mug replaces the warning triangle when something needs attention.
  • Brewmeister is now called Bromehew: app, menu bar app (Bromehew Menu), Xcode project, targets and scheme carry the new name, and the repository lives at github.com/appnoe/bromehew.
  • New bundle identifier com.appnoe.bromehew (menu bar app com.appnoe.bromehew.menu, askpass helper com.appnoe.bromehew.askpass). Settings are carried over once from Brewmeister. macOS treats the app as new: notification permission is asked again and an existing login item must be enabled again in Settings.

Fixed

  • Bromehew no longer lists its own cask as an update after it updated itself, and never upgrades, reinstalls or uninstalls it through Homebrew, which would quit the running app. With self-updating casks included, Upgrade All… upgrades formulae and the other casks by name instead of brew upgrade --greedy ([#3](https://github.com/appnoe/bromehew/issues/3)).
  • The UI test for Upgrade All… clicked a Touch Bar button instead of Cancel in the confirmation.
